item.title: Trump threatens Iran with "decapitation" as Houthis claim strike on Saudi airport
item.description: Trump threatened Tehran with "decapitation" Monday, before Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claimed to have struck a Saudi airport.

item.title: Family "forever grateful" after 10-year-old rescued from rip current by teen lifeguard
item.description: A 16-year-old lifeguard is being hailed a hero after rescuing a boy from a rip current off the coast of Santa Cruz, California, last month.

item.description: Some White House officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits his congressional race immediately, and President Trump has expressed a similar sentiment, multiple sources say.

item.description: President Trump threatened Iran with "decapitation" as questions surround a possible deal on the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Imtiaz Tyab has the latest.

item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Tuesday that a possible U.S.-Iran deal that would open the Strait of Hormuz might be within reach. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has the latest.

item.title: Primary elections underway in 5 states as Michigan Democrats battle for Senate seat
item.description: Primaries are underway in Kansas, Michigan, Missouri, Virginia and Washington, with the battle between Michigan Democratic Senate hopefuls Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed taking center stage. CBS News' Aaron Navarro has more.

item.title: Key Senate committee advances Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination despite DOJ fund fears
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination on Tuesday. Meanwhile, former chief medical adviser Dr. Anthony Fauci is facing a contempt vote after last week's hearing on Capitol Hill. CBS News' Taurean Small has more.

item.title: Dodgers make waves with major trade deadline moves
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers made some controversial moves ahead of Monday's Major League Baseball trade deadline. CBS Sports baseball writer Matt Snyder has more.

item.title: Cat helps senior shelter dogs find their forever homes
item.description: One dedicated and lifesaving animal shelter employee is helping dogs find forever homes in San Francisco. Little Dude serves as Muttville Senior Dog Rescue's director of feline relations, giving dogs "cat scans" to see if they can be socialized with cats. CBS News' Itay Hod reports.

item.title: Pirro brought box of evidence to show Trump what caused Reflecting Pool damage
item.description: U.S. Attorney for D.C. Jeanine Pirro was seen with a large box as she left the White House Monday after her meeting with President Trump.

item.title: Arson suspect in Spokane-area wildfire had prior manslaughter conviction
item.description: More than 700 buildings in the Spokane area have been destroyed and 400 more haven't been assessed, officials said as three fires burned in the area and an arrest was made in connection with one of them.

item.title: More adults are moving in with their parents as the U.S. affordability crisis deepens
item.description: With inflation and rising costs, the affordability crisis is prompting some adults to consider rooming with their parents. CBS News' Jericka Duncan spoke with a 34-year-old woman about her decision to move back home.

item.title: Man dies in ICE custody at Delaney Hall facility in New Jersey, DHS confirms
item.description: Salvadoran migrant Edwin Lopez-Cornejo died while in U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody at Delaney Hall in New Jersey, the Department of Homeland Security confirms, adding Lopez-Cornejo "experienced a medical emergency." Delaney Hall has been at the center of months of protests after a group of detainees held a hunger strike, citing dire conditions inside. CBS News New York's Allen Devlin reports.

item.title: Dramatic photos show lava spewing from Fuego volcano in Guatemala
item.description: Guatemalan officials on Monday began evacuating two villages near the Fuego volcano due to the ongoing eruption.

item.title: Wayward SpaceX rocket to slam into moon, leave 16-foot deep crater
item.description: The impact will not be visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: Gaza holds mass funeral for extended family recovered from wartime rubble
item.description: Authorities described this as the Gaza Strip's biggest mass funeral since the war began, mourning dozens of people, including women and children, recently recovered from the rubble.

item.title: Watch: Cory Booker slams Todd Blanche for Trump connections ahead of confirmation vote
item.description: Sen. Cory Booker laid into Todd Blanche ahead of the Senate Judiciary Committee's confirmation vote on his attorney general bid, saying, "We will rue the day that we let this man have this much power under such a corrupt president."

item.title: Full interview: Haley Stevens on race against Abdul El-Sayed, views on Israel and Trump
item.description: Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens, a moderate, is facing off against progressive Abdul El-Sayed in the Democratic Senate primary that is highlighting splits among some Democrats over their priorities. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke to Stevens about her opponent, her views on President Trump's administration, and the questions about American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) donations for her campaign.

item.title: Full Interview: Abdul El-Sayed makes progressive case as Democrats weigh race against Haley Stevens
item.description: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed, a doctor by trade, is facing off against Moderate Rep. Haley Stevens in the Michigan Senate primary, which reflects the split among some Democrats over their voting priorities. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke to El-Sayed about his Senate bid, his view on the Democratic Socialists of America, and how he would work alongside established Democrats if he makes it to Capitol Hill.

item.description: Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens, one of two Democrats in the primary for her party's Senate nomination, stands firm on backing U.S. military aid to Israel and claims opponent Abdul El-Sayed doesn't recognize Israel's right to exist.

item.title: Trump says Jeanine Pirro "choked" in dropping Reflecting Pool cases

item.description: Populist Abdul El-Sayed and Rep. Haley Stevens top the Democratic field going into Tuesday's Senate primary. Former Rep. Mike Rogers is running unopposed for the GOP nomination.

item.title: Dr. Anthony Fauci on pandemics, partisan critics, and "the psyche of the country"
item.description: Millions today owe their lives to the work of the man who devoted his career to public health, but in recent years Dr. Anthony Fauci has been targeted by a partisan, anti-science spectrum of opponents.
